decisions.briefing: Market was flat today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P500 -0.0%) with no major directional catalyst. With 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold, we deployed into PARR and NXT, the two top-scored candidates showing full technical confirmation (RSI, MACD, volume, trend) rather than letting cash sit idle.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially flat, with NASDAQ and S&P 500 both closing near breakeven, indicating a lack of strong conviction from buyers or sellers today. No major macro catalysts moved the broad market, so stock-specific momentum (like PARR and NXT) stood out more than index-level trends. In quiet, low-volatility sessions like this, individual technical setups tend to drive relative performance rather than market-wide sentiment.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢持平,納斯達克與標普500指數均收在接近平盤的水平,顯示買賣雙方都缺乏明確方向。由於今日沒有重大宏觀消息衝擊大盤,個股層面的技術動能(例如PARR與NXT)反而比指數走勢更為突出。在這種低波動的平淡交易日,個股的技術面訊號往往比大盤情緒更能決定相對表現。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means waiting for several independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD crossover, rising volume, and price above a moving average — to all point the same direction before trading, rather than acting on just one signal. This reduces the chance of being fooled by random noise or a single false signal.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指在交易前,等待多個獨立的技術指標——例如RSI、MACD黃金交叉、成交量放大,以及股價站上均線——同時指向同一方向,而不是僅依賴單一訊號就下單。這樣可以降低被隨機波動或單一假訊號誤導的風險。
